description: Update a page's own heading and look, and FILL ITS BLOCKS IN ONE CALL. Omitted fields are left alone; an empty string removes that heading slot. `blocks` takes the payload each block's archetype takes, so a template applied and then filled costs two calls rather than one per block; every block is checked before any is written, so a refusal changes nothing. The frame's SHAPE and where content sits in it are the document's — set_document.

accent.description: Where a full-bleed picture sits on this page. `lead` and `trail` DIVIDE the page — the picture owns that side and text cannot enter it. `top` is a banner across the frame; use it for a WIDE photograph, because a full-height column crops a landscape badly. `full` puts the picture behind everything with the text over it. null removes the accent AND its picture. Set accentSrc in the same call.

accentAlt.description: What the accent picture shows, for anyone who cannot see it.

accentSrc.description: The full web address of the accent picture — one that is ALREADY online. Ignored unless the page has an accent.

accentTreatment.description: How the theme paints the accent picture: `tint` drains it and dyes it in the theme's own colour, so photographs from different sources read as one deck; `mono` only drains it. null shows it as it came. Prefer `tint` on any stock photograph.

align.description: Where THIS page's content sits in the frame's free space — `top`, `middle` or `bottom` — overriding the document's. A cover or a divider reads best `bottom`; leave every other page to inherit. null goes back to inheriting.

animate.description: How this page's blocks enter, overriding the document's: none, fade, rise or grow. null inherits.

blocks.description: THE FAST PATH AFTER add_page — the page arrives composed and placeholder-written, and this replaces every slot in ONE call.

arrangement.description: Its shape or figure — the names the archetype's add_ tool takes on `arrangement`. Omit to keep the template's.

blockId.description: A block id, from add_page or get_document.

arrangement.description: This block's shape, where its kind has more than one — text takes md, lg, xl, hero, sm. Omit to leave it alone; null clears it back to the default.

attribution.description: A quote's source, on the SAME line as its text — only the 'quote' kind draws it. Echo it back on an update or it is removed.

checked.description: Whether a 'checklist' line is ticked. Defaults to unticked; only that kind stores it. Echo it back on an update or the tick is cleared.

depth.description: How deep a list item is nested. 0 is the outermost and is the default. A depth more than one deeper than the line before it is clamped, never refused. Only list kinds use it.

id.description: Echo an id from get_document to update that entry in place. Omit to create one.

kind.description: The block's own kind, if you echo it — a different one is refused, because changing what a block IS is set_block. Omit it and nothing changes.

language.description: A code fence's language, such as js, python or sql. Only the 'code' kind stores it. Nothing colours it (there is no syntax highlighter); it travels with the document and out to markdown again.

level.description: A heading's level, 1 to 6, exactly as markdown's # to ###### are. Defaults to 3. Only 'heading' draws it. Echo it back on an update or the heading returns to 3.

text.description: The line itself, as plain text. No markdown, no HTML — the theme owns the look. A newline is a real line break. A 'separator' takes none and is refused if you send one.

entries.description: items, stats or media — what set_block takes.

iconPosition.description: Where its icons sit: top, lead, none. Only a block that draws icons takes it.

mark.description: What its items are marked with — steps: numeral, icon, none | timeline: dot, icon — as add_block takes it.

variant.description: The block's style — a core name such as accent-bar, soft-fill, outlined, each glossed on add_block's own `variant`. Choose one; omit to keep the template's.

build.description: Whether this page's blocks all arrive with it or one per click. null inherits.

eyebrow.description: Small label above the title — section or number. Pass '' to remove it.

mode.description: Override the document's light/dark for THIS page only. null to go back to inheriting.

notes.description: The presenter's own text for this page, as markdown — never shown on the slide itself, only in the presenter view. Plain **bold** and lists work; pictures do not. null removes it.

pace.description: How fast this page's blocks and words enter: slow, medium or fast. null inherits.

subtitle.description: A line under the title. Pass '' to remove it.

surface.description: The page's own background, as a NAME the theme resolves — so swapping the theme repaints it. null goes back to the theme's ordinary paper.

title.description: The page's heading. Pass '' to remove it.

name: set_page
title: Set a page's heading, look or block content
